0022600020.text: The Miami Heat (1-4, 0-3 at home, 14th in the East) host the Indiana Pacers (2-3, on a two-game losing streak, 9th in the East) in this Emirates NBA Cup East Group B matchup, the sixth game of the season for Miami. Miami will be without Simone Fontecchio, who is out with an illness, while Indiana is missing Ben Sheppard (knee), Ivica Zubac (ankle sprain), Johnny Furphy (knee surgery), T.J. McConnell (hamstring strain), and Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Heat lost the 2025-26 season series 1-2, including a 135-118 defeat in Indianapolis on March 29, 2026.
